name: vllm_fused_qk_norm_rope
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_fused_qk_norm_rope.py. Fused per-head RMSNorm of Q/K followed by RoPE, in-place on qkv (seq_len, (nq+nk+nv)*head_dim). Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.fused_qk_norm_rope(qkv, num_heads_q, num_heads_k, num_heads_v, head_dim, eps, q_weight, k_weight, cos_sin_cache, is_neox, position_ids) and returns the mutated qkv. qkv/q_weight/k_weight/cos_sin_cache are plain random; position_ids = arange(seq_len) int64 is built in gen_inputs so it indexes cos_sin_cache in range. Source parametrizes is_neox in {False,True}; migrated workloads fix is_neox=True and eps=1e-5. No torch fallback; requires vLLM at eval time.
